active_color.description: Color of the widget during active countdown
active_color.label: Active Color

color.description: Accent color for the desktop widget
color.label: Accent Color

compact_mode.description: Use a single-line compact layout for the desktop widget
compact_mode.label: Compact Layout

custom_command.description: Shell command to run when 'Custom Command' action is chosen
custom_command.label: Custom Command

default_action.description: Default action to preselect when opening the setup panel
default_action.label: Default Action

default_duration.description: Default duration in minutes for new timers
default_duration.label: Default Duration (min)

font_size.description: Font size for the countdown timer text on desktop
font_size.label: Timer Font Size

idle_text.description: Text displayed on the bar widget when no timer is active
idle_text.label: Idle Bar Display

lock_command.description: Custom command to lock screen (leave empty for auto-detect)
lock_command.label: Lock Command Override

logout_command.description: Custom command to log out (leave empty for auto-detect)
logout_command.label: Log Out Command Override

paused_color.description: Color of the widget when timer is paused
paused_color.label: Paused Color

quick_timers.description: Comma-separated list of quick preset durations in minutes
quick_timers.label: Quick Presets

reboot_command.description: Custom command to reboot (leave empty for systemctl/loginctl)
reboot_command.label: Reboot Command Override

show_action_icon.description: Show action-specific icon instead of moon icon during countdown
show_action_icon.label: Show Action Icon

show_action_label.description: Display the action label (e.g., Lock Screen) on the widget
show_action_label.label: Show Action Label

show_countdown_text.description: Show countdown time text next to the bar icon
show_countdown_text.label: Show Countdown Text

show_percentage.description: Show remaining time percentage on the desktop widget
show_percentage.label: Show Percentage

show_progress.description: Show a progress bar on the desktop widget
show_progress.label: Show Progress Bar

show_when_idle.description: Show the widget even when no timer is currently active
show_when_idle.label: Show When Idle

shutdown_command.description: Custom command to shut down (leave empty for systemctl/loginctl)
shutdown_command.label: Shutdown Command Override

suspend_command.description: Custom command to suspend (leave empty for systemctl/loginctl)
suspend_command.label: Suspend Command Override

warning_color.description: Color used when the timer enters the warning threshold
warning_color.label: Warning Color

warning_enabled.description: Show warning notifications before performing the action
warning_enabled.label: Enable Warning Notifications

warning_seconds.description: How many seconds before action execution to start warning notifications
warning_seconds.label: Warning Threshold (seconds)

warning_sound.description: Play sound with warning notifications (if supported)
warning_sound.label: Warning Sound
